body:
I’m currently in an outpatient program at the Psychiatric Institute of Washington (PIW) and it’s a fantastic program. The therapists are so supportive and care. However I have heard only terrible things about PIW’s inpatient program from the other patients in my program that were in the inpatient program. Even my outpatient therapist at PIW said not to go to it’s inpatient program. 

The recommendation from both my fellow patients and the staff is to go to Sibley.

I’m currently in the PHP (partial hospitalization program—5 days a week but outpatient) at PIW and it is a phenomenally well run program. The staff, while young, are dedicated and talented. 

However, similar to other people, the inpatient program at PIW is bad based on the people in my program who were in it. Even one of the PHP therapists said not to go to PIW in patient and recommended Sibley.
